name: NSL Foods Public Company Limited
summary: Established in 2003 and headquartered in Nonthaburi, Thailand, NSL Foods Public Company Limited specializes in the production and distribution of an extensive range of bakery and snack items across the country. Their diverse product portfolio encompasses various snacks, baked goods, desserts, and other food offerings. Furthermore, the company engages in the wholesale supply of frozen and processed seafood (fish, aquatic products), meats, seaweeds, and vegetables. They also provide meat processing services tailored for institutional clients such as restaurants, hotels, catering companies, and international schools. NSL Foods markets its products under several well-known brands, including Ezy Taste, Ezy Sweet, Ezy Bake, 7 Fresh, KhowThang (also known as Rice bar by NSL), Pangtai, Natural Bite, NSL Bakery, and NSL Selection. These items are made available through a broad network of retail outlets, including convenience stores, supermarkets, wholesalers, hypermarkets, cash-and-carry formats, traditional markets, grocery stores, and gift shops.
